# Third-party copies

Copies of pub.dev packages, from the archive whose sha256 matches `pubspec.lock` before the copy. Each copy keeps the code as upstream wrote it, with its LICENSE, and only the files that we import.

| Package | Version | Files kept |
|---|---|---|
| `flutter_markdown` | 0.7.7+1 | `lib/` |
| `skeletonizer` | 3.0.0 | `lib/` |
| `thirds` | 0.2.0-alpha.1 | `lib/blake3.dart`, `lib/src/format.dart` |
| `qr_flutter` | 4.1.0 | `lib/` |
| `logger` | 2.8.0 | `lib/` |
